thread:
Anya: Heads-up — console charts on canary (canary-20260312) are ~2.5x slower. Heatmap and sparklines notably bad, LCP spikes.
deploy-bot: deploy: console/canary-20260312 finished by matt :rocket:
matt: Ack. Any obvious signal? bundle size bump or runtime change?
Anya: Two suspects: (1) telemetry sampler PR landed this morning, (2) prefetch TTL tweak from 10m -> 2m. Both could increase parse/cache churn.
sara: I grabbed a quick flamegraph from a slow load: https://gist.github.com/redwood/heatmap-flame-abc123 :eyes:
joel: Metrics show kvcache.evictions surged around the deploy window. quick numbers: `kvcache.evictions{env=canary} 320 -> 1180`.
kai: The telemetry sampler change (PR #4821) pulls in a small import on client init. That extra import is ~80-140ms parse on main thread depending on bundle splitting.
Anya: Repro steps I used:
```
curl -H "x-redwood-canary: canary-20260312" "https://console.redwood/api/ui/heatmap?range=1h&rows=500"
# then e.g. open with chrome devtools throttling CPU 4x
```
When sampler import is present, first paint and parse time both increase and we see extra chunk downloads (dup sourcemap entries).
sara: Short-term options: revert sampler flag or gate it behind rollout %; also revert TTL to 10m to reduce KV churn.
matt: Rolling back sampler on canary now :wrench:
deploy-bot: rollback: console/canary-20260312 -> console/canary-20260311 completed by matt :white_check_mark:
joel: After rollback eviction rate dropped ~65% in the last 2 minutes. Still want to address TTL and prefetch concurrency though.
kai: Suggestion: cap client prefetch concurrency to 6 and restore TTL to 10m. Quick test locally reduced eviction rate in my profile.
Anya: Agreed. Can someone open quick PR to: 1) revert sampler default, 2) restore prefetch TTL, 3) add concurrent_prefetch cap? I'll re-run canary after PR.
sara: I'll open PR and assign to @matt. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/XXXX (wip)
matt: I'll review. Also please add telemetry panels for `bundle.parse_ms` and `kvcache.eviction_rate` so future rollouts surface faster.
Anya: Also adding a rollout checklist item: "smoke heatmap + legend + sparklines under throttled CPU" to prevent main-thread parse regressions.
joel: FYI check ALB/routing: some EU traffic was routed to a different asset hash this morning due to CDN invalidation race — that can amplify cache misses when TTLs are short.
Anya: Good catch — we'll verify routing affinity during the canary. Thanks everyone, will post follow-up with canary numbers in #eng-oncall later :pray:
